'''Cornelius Greither''' (born 1956)<ref name="MAK">{{cite web |title=981058766320560 |url=http://mak.bn.org.pl/cgi-bin/KHW/makwww.exe?BM=1&NU=1&IM=4&WI=9810587663205606 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211011091447/http://mak.bn.org.pl/cgi-bin/KHW/makwww.exe?BM=1&NU=1&IM=4&WI=9810587663205606 |archive-date=11 October 2021 |access-date=3 October 2021 |website=Biblioteka Narodowa}}</ref> is a [[Germany|German]] [[mathematician]] specialising in [[Iwasawa theory]] and the structure of [[Galois module]]s.<ref name="timor">{{cite web |title= Univ.-Prof. Dr. Cornelius Greither |url=https://www.unibw.de/timor/mitarbeiter/greither |access-date=3 October 2021}}</ref>

== Education and career ==

Greither completed his [[Doctor of Philosophy|PhD]] in 1983 at [[LMU Munich]] under the supervision of Bodo Pareigis:<ref name="MGP">{{MathGenealogy|id=29687}}</ref> his thesis bears the title ''Zum Kürzungsproblem kommutativer Algebren''.<ref name="nichtref">{{cite web |title=Nichtreferierte Publikationen |url=https://www.unibw.de/timor/mitarbeiter/greither/nonrefpublist |access-date=3 October 2021}}</ref>
He [[habilitation|habilitated]] in 1988 at same [[university]], with thesis title ''Cyclic Galois extensions and normal bases''.<ref name="nichtref"/>

In 1992, Greither proved the [[Iwasawa main conjecture]] for [[abelian number field]]s in the <math>p=2</math> case.<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Greither |first1=Cornelius |title=Class groups of abelian fields, and the main conjecture |journal=Annales de l'Institut Fourier |date=1992 |volume=42 |issue=3 |pages=449–499 |doi=10.5802/aif.1299|doi-access=free }}</ref><ref>{{cite book |last1=Washington |first1=Lawrence C. |title=Introduction to Cyclotomic Fields |date=1997 |publisher=Springer |page=372 |edition=2}}</ref>
In 1999, together with D.&nbsp;R.&nbsp;Rapogle, [[Karl Rubin|K.&nbsp;Rubin]], and A.&nbsp;Srivastav, he proved a converse to the [[Hilbert–Speiser theorem]].<ref>{{Citation | last1=Greither | first1=Cornelius | last2=Replogle | first2=Daniel R. | last3=Rubin | first3=Karl | last4=Srivastav | first4=Anupam | title=Swan modules and Hilbert–Speiser number fields | journal=Journal of Number Theory | volume=79 | pages=164–173 | doi=10.1006/jnth.1999.2425 | year=1999| doi-access=free }}</ref>

Greither was a full professor at the [[University of the Bundeswehr Munich]]. He retired in 2022,<ref>{{Cite web |date=2021-10-03 |title=Universitätsprofessur (W3) für Mathematik - Universität der Bundeswehr München - academics |url=https://www.academics.de/jobs/universitaetsprofessur-w3-fuer-mathematik-universitaet-der-bundeswehr-muenchen-muenchen-1045452 |access-date=2023-12-28 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211003133713/https://www.academics.de/jobs/universitaetsprofessur-w3-fuer-mathematik-universitaet-der-bundeswehr-muenchen-muenchen-1045452 |archive-date=2021-10-03 |url-status=live }}</ref> and he is now an [[emeritus]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Ehemalige Mitarbeiter |url=https://www.unibw.de/timor/mitarbeiter/ehemalige-mitarbeiter |access-date=2023-12-28 |website=Universität der Bundeswehr München |language=de}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Univ.-Prof. Dr. Andreas Nickel |url=https://www.unibw.de/timor/mitarbeiter/univ-prof-dr-andreas-nickel |access-date=2023-12-28 |website=Universität der Bundeswehr München |language=de}}</ref>

Greither is on the editorial boards of the journals ''[[Archivum Mathematicum (Brno)]]'',<ref name="timor"/><ref>{{cite web |url=http://emis.impa.br/EMIS/journals/AM/ed_board.html |title=Masaryk University, Archivum Mathematicum |website=emis.impa.br |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211003133703/http://emis.impa.br/EMIS/journals/AM/ed_board.html |archive-date=2021-10-03}} </ref> ''[[New York Journal of Mathematics]]'',<ref name="timor"/><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://nyjm.albany.edu/edboard.htm|title = NYJM Editorial Board}}</ref> as well as the ''[[Journal de Théorie des Nombres de Bordeaux]]''.<ref name="timor"/><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://jtnb.math.u-bordeaux.fr/jtnbedit_english.html|title = Journal de Théorie des Nombres de Bordeaux}}</ref> Until 2014, he was an associate editor of ''Annales mathématiques du Québec''.<ref name="timor"/><ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.labmath.uqam.ca/~annales/english/redaction.html|title = ASMQ - Editorial Board}}</ref>
